margaret keaney (née murphy) month’s mind billy & bridget king late of new road paris h notic es we pray for all of the recently deceased especially those who have no one to remember them. may all of their gentle so uls rest in peace. second collection: mission sunday : is taken up at all masses across many countries to support parishes and dioceses that struggle to make ends meet. your contribution will help parishes in places like africa, asia and south america. it will help pay for catechism teachers, parish schools, diocesan nursing homes, the education of student priests and religious sisters, and many other projects. your contribution is an act of solidarity with our brothers and sisters throughout the church. on saturday, october 17th : the dioceses of clonfert, galway, kilmacduagh and kilfenora were represented by eleven delegates at the national assembly of the church in ireland which took place in gormanston, co meath. please continue to pray for this ongoing process of national discernment so that it might inspire and guide our steps as a community of faith into the future. autumn dues: envelopes will be distributed over the next weeks. contributions can be placed into the baskets at mass or left into the office or the parochial house 24, presentation road. thank you all. november lists of dead : our remembrance novena will take place from monday 2nd nov until wednesday 11th nov inclusive. repair cafes : simply drop in with any clothing repairs and we can help mend for free. electrical repairs need to be booked ahead
